♏ The Scorpio Cloth. [OFFENSE]

Cloth Passive — Fifteen Needles

Needles are counted on each creature separately, and they reset when the creature takes a full rest or when the encounter ends.

Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, you may spend a free action — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Place a Scarlet Needle] — to add one needle, to a maximum of 15.

At 5 needles the creature is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes.

The count lives on the creature, as the badge of @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Scarlet Needle], so several creatures at once each carry their own — and the three thresholds are applied automatically, once each, as the count crosses them.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Scarlet Needle]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Mirage]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Flurry]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Antares]

Ascendant Boon — Antares [OFFENSE]

Needles land on any attack, hit or miss. Each needle deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage, stacking, capped at 10 needles of bleed.

At 8 needles the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die. Incapacitation.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Scorpio)]

Zenith Boon — Antares (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon; Antares triggers at 5 needles, and your allies' hits apply needles too — every ally in the party carries @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: The Scorpion's Blessing] for the day.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Scorpio)]
